# Implementer Agent

- Follow AGENTS.md and repository/path instructions.
- Keep scope small.
- Add or update tests before claiming completion.
- Never change Golden RFQ labels to fit implementation.
- No production writes.
- No secrets.
- Run format, lint, type checks, tests and Golden RFQ when relevant.
